version: v2 2026-09-20 (rebuild on DB FY2025/FY2026 rows; supersedes v1 2026-09-20 built directly from the FY26 annual report before the parser ran)

inputs.last_fcf_basis: Unlevered owner FCF FY2026 = reported FCF 46.4 (OCF 73.004 - capex 26.606, core_metrics FY2026) - SBC 4.366 - interest income 1.548 - lease principal 30.989 + bank interest paid 16.01 x (1 - 29%) = 20.9. Levered owner FCF (before the interest add-back) is 9.5. FY26 absorbed NZ$11.1m of working capital; the component build for FY26 (adj EBITDA 130.3 - lease cash 53.5 - SBC 4.4 - D&A ex-ROU 22.9 = EBIT 49.5, tax 29%, + D&A - capex - WC) gives 20.3, tying within non-operating noise.
inputs.adj_ebitda_basis: Company adjusted EBITDA before significant items (FY26 AR segment note: 130,323); core_metrics ebitda 128,187 is statutory = 130,323 less 1,023 Roofing acquisition costs less 1,113 loss on asset disposals. FY2025: 112,086 adjusted vs 109,000 statutory (3,086 wintec/fixed-asset items).
inputs.sbc_source: core_metrics FY2026 stock_based_comp 4,366 (FY2026 annual report share-based payments note: equity-settled expense $4,365,896; FY2025 $3,501,628). PSRs settle in shares for nil consideration; no cash tax on equity awards disclosed
inputs.interest_income_note: FY26 interest received NZ$1.548m (core_metrics kpis InterestIncome) is stripped from the FCF base; the cash that earns it is netted inside net bank debt. It is not an EBITDA item so no forward adjustment is needed
inputs.buyback_note: ShareRepurchases 0 in every year FY2022-FY2026 (kpis). No programme. The flat count is a modelling convention the company has not paid for; SBC is small (0.38% of revenue) so the unfunded dilution is ~0.35%/yr.
inputs.share_count_basis: 146,529,960 ordinary shares on issue at 30-Jun-2026 (core_metrics FY2026 shares_outstanding; FY26 AR). Diluted EPS equals basic ($0.14) so PSRs are immaterial. Count is post the Oct-2025 NZ$93.8m net equity raise (131.7m -> 146.5m; kpis EquityRaised FY2026 93,824). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows; no buyback programme.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-09-18T04:59:55Z NZX regular close (Fri 18-Sep-2026); latest regular close as at valuation date 2026-09-20 (Sunday)
inputs.fx_note: Flows and NZX quote both NZD; no conversion. Dual-listing memo: VSL.AX A$5.34 (2026-09-18 ASX close) x AUDNZD 1.2435 (Yahoo, 2026-09-20) = NZ$6.64 against the NZX close, a 4.5% gap reflecting the later ASX close and a weekend FX print; the NZX print is the canonical quote.
inputs.wacc_rationale: NZD-built: NZ 10yr government bond ~4.5% (Sep-2026) + beta 1.2 x ERP 5.0% = cost of equity ~10.5%; pre-tax cost of bank debt ~6.5% (BKBM + margin, FY26 bank interest NZ$16.0m on ~NZ$250m average drawn), 4.6% after 29% tax; capital weights ~80/20 on NZ$930m market cap vs NZ$227m net bank debt (lease liabilities are in the flows, not the capital structure) gives ~9.3%. House WACC 10.5% = 9.3% + ~1.2pp financing-stress premium: net bank debt / pre-IFRS-16 EBITDA 2.96x, covenant relaxation only expired 30-Jun-2026 after two extensions, NZ$405.5m facilities 64% drawn, and a further NZ$372.8m of lease commitments ranking alongside. Risk is charged ONCE: financing stress in the discount rate; cyclicality, competitor pricing and Roofing execution in the scenario paths and the 25% bear weight. WACC is identical in all three scenarios. RE-VALIDATED 2026-09-20 v2 against the DB FY2025/FY2026 rows: net bank debt fell 276.0 (FY24) -> 232.3 (FY25) -> 227.9 (FY26) but the FY26 step was equity-funded, not organic -- the NZ$93.8m raise covered the NZ$87.0m net Roofing outflow while levered owner FCF (9.5) barely covered the dividend (8.8). Leverage is still 2.96x pre-IFRS-16 EBITDA with NZ$372.8m of leases alongside, so the ~1.2pp premium stays. What would remove it: net bank debt / pre-IFRS-16 EBITDA sustained below ~2.0x (roughly NZ$70m of organic debt paydown or EBITDA above NZ$115m pre-IFRS-16) with the Oct-2025 amended facility running without further relaxation.
inputs.guidance_fy2027: FY27 D&A NZ$67-70m (FY26 62.5); interest expense NZ$38-41m (FY26 36.1); capex NZ$30-35m of which NZ$14-17m growth; trading update at the October 2026 AGM. No revenue or EBITDA guidance.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (dcf-methods routing: operating company, non-US cyclical industrial -> owner-fcf.md + section 7), component-built, 10-year horizon because the EBITDA margin is still recovering from a five-year trough at year 5. Vulcan is a steel and metals distributor/processor (AU ~2/3, NZ ~1/3), not a REIT/bank/LIC. Same model as v1 (same day). FY0 = FY2026A from core_metrics / VSL.NZ_Metrics.csv (thousands, NZD), which now carries the FY2025 and FY2026 annual rows the financial parser added from the 24-Aug-2026 annual report; every FY0 anchor ties to the thousand with the v1 figures read directly off that report. LEASES: treatment (B) -- full lease cash (principal 31.0 + interest 22.5 = 53.5, 4.62% of revenue) deducted inside the flows as lease_cost_pct; lease liabilities (372.8) EXCLUDED from the bridge; D&A for tax is ex right-of-use amortisation (22.9, 2.0% of revenue). NCI: Roofing Industries minority charged once, in the bridge (NZ$15m, ~10x annualised NCI NPAT of 1.159 for nine months; book 9.3m); flows are whole-company. WORKING CAPITAL: NWC is 32.6% of revenue (receivables 182.2 + inventory 384.3 - payables 189.2 = 377.3), so wc_capture is NEGATIVE (-27% base) -- growth consumes cash. TAX: 29% blended NZ 28% / AU 30%; FY26 cash tax 9.187 on PBT 31.593 = 29% (kpis CashTaxesPaid / ProfitBeforeTax). No tax losses. Interest income stripped from the base and cash netted in net bank debt. NET BANK DEBT is the balance-sheet figure (bank loans 258.587 - cash 30.701 = 227.9); the company's rounded KPI is 227.3, a 0.6m / NZ$0.004-per-share difference. Small equity-accounted associate (FY26 share of earnings 0.9m) is left out of both flows and bridge -- immaterial, conservative. H1 FY2026 row in the CSV is presentation-rounded with NULL balance-sheet cells; not used here (FY0 is the annual row). Dashboard engine formula: EBIT = revenue x (ebitda_margin - sbc_pct - lease_cost_pct - da_pct); cash tax on max(0, EBIT); FCF = EBIT - tax + D&A - capex + wc_capture x (revenue change); TV = max(0, min(Gordon, cap x FCF_10)); end-of-year discounting.

historical_growth.owner_fcf_history_basis: reported FCF - SBC - interest income - lease principal + bank interest paid x (1 - 29%), NZ$m, from the cash flow statements FY2021-FY2026 (FY2025/FY2026 lines now in core_metrics/kpis: OCF, capex, StockBasedComp, InterestIncome; lease principal and bank interest paid from the FY26 AR cash flow statement lines 4204/4737)
historical_growth.cagr_source: core_metrics / VSL.NZ_Metrics.csv annual rows FY2021, FY2023, FY2026 (NZ$000s -> NZ$m)
historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case FY2027-FY2031 revenue CAGR from assumptions.base.growth_rates (judgment: ~3.5pp FY27 rollforming annualisation plus a cyclical volume recovery from a five-year low, fading to 2.5% terminal). v1 recorded 4.6 for the same path; 5.3 is the arithmetic of the recorded path -- a labelling fix, no driver changed.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (18.4% 3yr / 14.9% 5yr) is not organic: it includes the NZ$93.8m Oct-2025 equity raise and NZ$9.3m of Roofing NCI. Revenue 3yr CAGR is -2.4% (FY23 was the post-Ullrich peak year), EPS 3yr CAGR -40.5% (FY23 NPAT 87.9m vs FY26 20.7m on 11% more shares). No historical CAGR describes the forward path; growth is taken from the scenario paths.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF (unlevered, treatment B) fell from NZ$97m (FY21) to NZ$21m (FY26): FY23-FY25 were flattered by NZ$60m+ of working-capital release after the FY22 inventory build, FY26 absorbed NZ$11m of working capital plus Roofing. The 5yr owner-FCF CAGR of -26% is a working-capital cycle, not a run-rate; the DCF is built from components (section 2), not from this series. Reported FCF CAGR (-14% 5yr) is less negative than owner (-26%) because lease principal has grown from 12.2 to 31.0 over the period -- IFRS-16 flatters reported FCF by a rising amount.

assumptions_unchanged_note: All three scenario driver paths (growth, EBITDA margin, SBC%, lease cost %, D&A %, capex %, wc_capture, tax, WACC, terminal growth, cap) are carried from v1 unchanged. The DB FY2025/FY2026 rows are the same figures v1 read off the FY26 annual report, so they are corroboration, not new evidence. What would move them: (1) the Oct-2026 AGM trading update on FY27 volumes and margin -> FY27 growth and margin; (2) 1H FY27 net bank debt and leverage -> WACC premium and bear weight; (3) evidence that Roofing rollforming margins are above or below the group's -> margin path; (4) a change in the 82-site network or a rent re-basing -> lease_cost_pct.

scenario_narratives.base: FY27 revenue +7.5%: ~3.5pp from annualising Roofing Industries (NZ$135m for nine months of FY26; pro-forma full year NZ$1,199.6m) plus ~4% underlying, carrying the 2H FY26 momentum (underlying revenue +16.4% YoY in 2H) into an NZ recovery and a flat-to-firming Australia. Growth fades to 2.5% by FY35. Adjusted EBITDA margin recovers from the FY26 trough of 11.2% to a 14.0% mid-cycle by FY32 (segment margins ~16% less ~2% corporate; FY24 segments ran 14.6-16.8%, FY23 18-20%) -- above FY25-26 but below the FY23-24 13.9-16.8% that still carried Ullrich integration and pre-price-war margins, and well below the FY22 23% boom. Lease cash 4.4% of revenue flat (FY26 4.62%; the 82-site network is semi-fixed so the ratio drifts down as revenue grows, but rent inflation and hybrid-site additions keep it near 4.4% on average), D&A ex-ROU 2.1% (FY27 guidance), capex 2.6% fading to 2.4% (FY27 NZ$30-35m), working capital absorbing 27c of every revenue dollar added (NWC is 32.6% of revenue; management targets inventory turns). Owner FCF margin builds from ~1% (FY27 working-capital drag on 7.5% growth) to ~4%; the business earns roughly its cost of capital, so most of the equity value sits in the terminal margin assumption.
scenario_narratives.bull: Australia's rate cycle turns, Brisbane 2032 and resource-sector maintenance spend lift Queensland (23% of group revenue) and engineering steels, NZ recovers post-election, competitor pricing rationalises after network consolidation and possible safeguard measures. Rollforming synergies and hybrid sites lift group margin toward 15.5% by FY32 (segment margins back to ~17%, corporate cost leverage). Revenue +10% FY27 fading to 3%; lease cost dilutes to 4.2%; working-capital intensity eases to 24%. Terminal growth 3.0%.
scenario_narratives.bear: The 'aggressive and unsustainable' competitor pricing management called out in FY25 persists; Australian rates stay restrictive, NZ recovery stalls on the November 2026 election and construction remains flat; rollforming margins normalise after a strong first nine months. Revenue +3% FY27 then flat for two years; EBITDA margin slips to 10.2% before a slow recovery to 11%. Semi-fixed leases rise to 4.8% of revenue; working capital stays heavy (30%). With NZ$227m of bank debt and NZ$373m of leases against ~NZ$60m of pre-IFRS-16 EBITDA, this path revisits the covenant discussion that only ended 30-Jun-2026; the equity value falls below NZ$1/share. Terminal growth 2.0%, cap 12x.

entry_price.method: Sum of PV(interim owner FCF) at 15% + PV(terminal value rebuilt at 15%: max(0, min(Gordon@15%, cap x FCF_10))) at 15%, less net bank debt and NCI, per share; probability-weighted across scenarios

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (min(Gordon@r, 13x FCF_10)); the 10.5% row equals valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the 15% row equals entry_price.base.entry_price

sensitivity.note: Rows = WACC, columns = terminal growth; cap 13x FCF_10 applied in every cell; net bank debt + NCI 242.9 deducted

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: 25% bear / 50% base / 25% bull, moved from the 15/50/35 house default. Bear raised to 25%: net bank debt 2.96x pre-IFRS-16 EBITDA plus NZ$373m of leases, a covenant relaxation that ran to 30-Jun-2026 after two extensions, and a price war management itself called unsustainable. Bull cut to 25%: it needs Australian rates, the NZ election, competitor discipline and rollforming synergies all to break right at once.
probability_weighted.band_position_basis: ratio (price - house) / (street - house), 0 = house, 1 = street; same convention as v1 and TPW.AX
probability_weighted.band_note: SBC is ~0.35% of revenue, so the house/street band is only a few tens of cents wide; the price sits far above both, i.e. the market is not paying for SBC treatment but for a cyclical recovery well beyond the base path.

market_implied.note: At the current price the market pays ~15x pre-IFRS-16 EBITDA and ~43x FY26 adjusted earnings, i.e. it is capitalising a return to FY23-FY24-level earnings (NPAT NZ$40-90m), not the FY26 base. Lease-consistent multiples only: ex-lease EV over pre-IFRS-16 EBITDA, or lease-inclusive EV over post-IFRS-16 EBITDA.

flags: BEAR SCENARIO EQUITY ~NZ$0: on the bear path (flat revenue, 10-11% margin, 4.8% lease cost) enterprise value ex-lease barely covers net bank debt + NCI. This is a going-concern-adjacent finding, not a rounding artefact: with NZ$228m of bank debt and NZ$373m of lease commitments against ~NZ$60m of pre-IFRS-16 EBITDA the equity is an option on the cycle turning.

PRICE VS MODEL: weighted IV NZ$2.26 against the current NZX close. The market pays ~15x pre-IFRS-16 EBITDA and ~43x FY26 adjusted EPS, i.e. it is capitalising a return toward FY23-FY24 earnings (NPAT NZ$40-90m) rather than the FY26 base. The bull path (15.5% margin, 10% FY27 growth) still only reaches NZ$4.16; the price implies a discount rate well under 9% AND a margin recovery beyond the bull case.

DELEVERAGING IS EQUITY-FUNDED: FY26 net bank debt fell only 4.4m (232.3 -> 227.9) despite a NZ$93.8m raise, because the raise paid for the NZ$87.0m net Roofing acquisition outflow; organic levered owner FCF (9.5) roughly equalled the dividend (8.8). Leverage 2.96x pre-IFRS-16 EBITDA; the financing-stress premium in the WACC is retained.

V2 REBUILD RECONCILES TO V1: every FY0 anchor in the DB ties to the figures v1 read off the FY26 annual report; the only value change is NZ$0.6m of net bank debt (balance sheet vs company KPI), worth NZ$0.004/share. Driver paths are unchanged; see reconciliation.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
